Poké Arena card illustrations, generated for this project on 2026-11-11 with Imagegen.
All scenes are opaque, full bleed, and depict the card's actual action and unit count.
The original Pokémon Mystery Dungeon sprites used on the battlefield are separate.

battle-1.webp through battle-5.webp: four columns by four rows, sixteen scenes per sheet.
battle-6.webp: two columns by one row, Groudon and Rayquaza.
Tile order, CSS crop positions, and varied display orientations are in dist/card-art.js.
WebP conversion preserves the full generated canvas and its original dimensions.

Pokémon characters belong to Nintendo, Creatures, and GAME FREAK.
Unofficial fan game.

The 19 expansion cards now use individually generated full-scene WebP illustrations (2026-11-12), replacing the SVG icon and cutout compositions. Prompts: docs/IMAGE-PROMPTS-EXPANSION.json. Full canvases are uniformly scaled to at most 768 × 960 pixels for mobile and converted to WebP quality 90.
